desc: Ideate core approach based on $\binom{N}{K} \le 10^6$ constraint.
Decide to iterate over the smaller subset (either chosen $K$ or excluded $N-K$) to minimize inner loop cost.
Compute total XOR of all elements in $A$.
Determine the subset size to iterate: $S = \min(K, N-K)$.
If $S == K$, iterate all combinations of indices of length $K$, compute XOR sum, update max.
If $S == N-K$, iterate all combinations of indices of length $N-K$, compute XOR of excluded elements, XOR with total XOR, update max.
Run the code against Sample 1 (`4 2`, `3 2 6 4`) to verify it outputs `7`.
Run the code against Sample 2 (`10 4`, `1516 1184 1361 2014 1013 1361 1624 1127 1117 1759`) to verify it outputs `2024`.
Mark as solved if all tests pass.
